question: What prosperity results from reciting the mantra one thousand and eight times?
premises: The recitation count is one thousand and eight.
The practitioner becomes endowed with cows.
The practitioner becomes endowed with fortune.
inference: Reciting the mantra one thousand and eight times makes the practitioner endowed with cows and fortune.
